# rixl Provider

The Rixl provider allows Terraform to manage Rixl platform resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    rixl = {
      source  = "rixlhq/rixl"
      version = ">= 0.0.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "rixl" {
  api_key = var.rixl_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Rixl API key. May also be set via the RIXL_API_KEY environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Rixl API base URL. Defaults to https://api.rixl.com. May also be set via the RIXL_BASE_URL environment variable.
- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) Rixl bearer token. May also be set via the RIXL_BEARER_TOKEN environment variable.
